# QAOAAnsatz

### default

```{python}
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import QAOAAnsatz
from qiskit.quantum_info import SparsePauliOp

# initial state
n = 4
initial = QuantumCircuit(n)
initial.x(0)      
initial.h(1)     

# mixer Hamiltonian
mixer = SparsePauliOp.from_sparse_list(
    [
        ("X",  [0],    1.0),   # X_0
        ("Y",  [1],    0.5),   # 0.5 Y_1
        ("XX", [2, 3], 1.0),   # X_2 X_3
    ],
    num_qubits=n,
)

# cost H
cost_H = SparsePauliOp.from_list(
    [
        ("IZYX", 1), 
    ]
)

qaoa_layer = 2

ansatz = QAOAAnsatz(
    cost_operator=cost_H,
    reps=qaoa_layer,
    initial_state=initial,
    mixer_operator=mixer,
    flatten=False, # 尽量直接展开 QAOA ansatz 的内部层级
)


ansatz.draw()
ansatz.decompose(reps=1).draw()
```
